objective: Redesign the next chart-ready trigger after P3 design rejection. Return exactly three machine-checkable semantically distinct discrete t0 trigger candidates using only existing finalized adjusted daily OHLCV. None may reuse MA-cross, close-to-MA reclaim, or close-above-prior/rolling-high breakout as the primary predicate or as a predicate with an added filter. Select exactly one rank-1 candidate. Do not write code, run experiments, invent acceptance thresholds, or claim profitability.
requiredOutputs: Exactly three PROPOSAL findings. Each claim must use exactly this field layout: CANDIDATE|featureId=<UPPER_SNAKE_ID>|family=<UPPER_SNAKE_FAMILY>|name=<short name>|t0=<exact D-1 to D causal condition>|fields=<OHLCV/derived inputs>|params=<minimal parameter search family>|warmup=<minimum bars>|chart=<marker/overlay semantics>|densityRisk=<brief risk>|distinct=<why not a closed trigger rescue>. Do not use the pipe character inside field values.
The three featureId values must be unique and the three family values must be unique.
Each t0 value must explicitly contain both D-1 and D and must describe a discrete transition, not a persistent state.
Summary must begin exactly RANK1|featureId=<one of the three featureIds>|reason=<brief rationale>.
nextActions must contain exactly one item beginning DISCOVERY_CONTRACT|featureId=<same rank-1 featureId>|parameterSearch=<bounded parameter family>|notes=<implementation-independent notes>.
Do not put Discovery acceptance thresholds in the candidate or next action; ranking/gates belong to Coordinator.
constraints: Use only resolved SOURCE inputIds for executable capability/data claims
No new data source, API, server, intraday feed, news, fundamentals, order book or broker state
Do not reuse MA versus MA crossing in any candidate t0
Do not reuse close crossing or reclaiming an MA in any candidate t0
Do not reuse close breaking above a prior or rolling high in any candidate t0
Do not take a closed trigger and add volume, volatility, MA ordering or any other context filter
Do not invent numeric profitability or acceptance thresholds
Completed D and earlier information only at decision t0; D+1 open remains executable entry reference
Do not run Discovery or Validation
